description: This file defines the UploadState class which manages and tracks the state of a multipart upload process in the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes constants for upload states, properties for upload parameters, methods to manipulate and query the upload state, such as setting IDs, part size, marking parts as uploaded, and checking status.

classes.name: UploadState
classes.description: Represents and manages the state of a multipart upload, including tracking uploaded parts and current status.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the upload state with a given ID array.

methods.name: setUploadId
methods.description: Sets or updates a specific part of the upload ID.

methods.name: getPartSize
methods.description: Returns the size of parts used in the upload.

methods.name: setPartSize
methods.description: Sets the size of upload parts.

methods.name: markPartAsUploaded
methods.description: Marks a specific part as uploaded with optional part data.

methods.name: hasPartBeenUploaded
methods.description: Checks if a specific part has been uploaded.

methods.name: getUploadedParts
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of all uploaded parts with their data.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the current upload status (CREATED, INITIATED, COMPLETED).

methods.name: isInitiated
methods.description: Checks if the upload is in the INITIATED state.

methods.name: isCompleted
methods.description: Checks if the upload is in the COMPLETED state.
